text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s race is drawing near. I believe she has 
put in plenty of mileage. Yet, I can't 
seem to shake this lingering anxiety...

Can we really win with this? How should we 
adjust? As I racked my brain――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You've got quite a troubled look on your 
face. Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: I'm starting to feel a bit anxious……

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I can understand that sentiment 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is best not to appear visibly 
shaken. You wouldn't want to make her 
anxious as well, would you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I think you should all have more 
confidence in yourselves. Neither the 
quantity nor the quality of your running 
is inferior to anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The results will speak for themselves. We 
must remain calm and wait. ...Though, 
easier said than done, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Some proof…… Very well, let me hear your 
proposed conditioning regimen for the 
upcoming race.
choice_data_list:
Focus on light speed practice heading into 
the race.

Toughen the routine deliberately to 
prepare for grueling races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Conserve stamina and focus primarily on 
speed, eh? Yes, just as expected. A sound, 
direct approach. It makes logical sense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True, the path you've chosen is 
well-trodden. That is precisely why you 
feel anxious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet, so long as one never takes a false 
step, that path can truly be called the 
imperial road to glory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You have the strength to keep walking that 
path. I truly believe that. Have 
confidence in yourselves.

Hearing Symboli Rudolf's words eased my 
anxieties and filled me with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So you want to get a solid run 
in to dispel any lingering doubts...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It may not be the conventional approach... 
but for who you are right now, it's the 
ideal adjustment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By running with reckless abandon, one can 
hopefully outrun every sorrow, doubt, and 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, your choice was not mistaken. 
Guide her forward with confidence.

Hearing Symboli Rudolf's words eased my 
anxieties and filled me with confidence.
